response.overview: Can we still be nomads?  The question is posed over a continuous sequence of images taken from the sky, which at first glance might seem to be the smoothest space imaginable. But is it not, on the contrary, a striated space?  Nomadic Routes is a reflection on the evolution of what can be called nomadic life, and on the ways in which states have appropriated and divided spaces, both on the ground and in the sky.
response.title: The Nomadic Routes
